492K likes, 3,903 comments - beautifuldestinations on February 13, 2026: "Chunda Valley in Skardu is one of the most peaceful places in northern Pakistan.

Tucked away in Gilgit-Baltistan, this hidden valley is known for its bright green meadows, glacier-fed streams and views of the Karakoram mountains. Just a short drive from Skardu town, it’s a favourite for travellers exploring northern Pakistan, Hunza and the wider Gilgit-Baltistan region.

Best time to visit: May to September for lush green landscapes, mild temperatures and clear mountain views. Spring and early summer bring wildflowers and flowing streams, while autumn offers golden tones and crisp air. Winters are beautiful but can be harsh, with snow and limited access.

If you’re planning a Pakistan travel itinerary, looking for quiet places in Skardu or searching for scenic valleys in northern Pakistan, Chunda Valley is one to add to your list.

📽️ @emtiaazhussain_
📍Chunda Valley, Skardu, Gilgit-Baltistan, Pakistan".

Relax on iconic beaches like Emerald Beach & Sunset Beach 🌊

1M likes, 2,753 comments - beautifuldestinations on December 22, 2024: "Ever seen a mountain that looks like a layered cake? 🎂🏔️ 

@danielkordan takes us to the stunning Bokty Mountain in West Kazakhstan! 🏞️ Rising 165 meters above the vast plains, this natural wonder is a masterpiece of vibrant layers, giving it the appearance of a giant cake 🍰. The mountain’s striking colors are at their most magical during sunrise and sunset, when they glow with fiery light, casting an ethereal glow over the landscape 🔥. 

💡Did you know this spot was once under an ancient ocean? Keep an eye out for fossilized shark teeth beneath your feet! 🦈 

📽️ @danielkordan
📍Bokty mountain, West Kazakhstan
🎶 Good Neighbours- Home
#beautifuldestinations #beautifulmountains #kazakhstantravel #placesthatdontfeelreal".

9,584 likes, 54 comments - beautifuldestinations on October 16, 2026: "This fairytale village in Germany looks like a Christmas film set, but it’s real!

Rothenburg ob der Tauber is a medieval town in Bavaria, Germany, filled with half-timbered houses, cobbled lanes and old town walls. At Christmas, its Reiterlesmarkt brings stalls and festive lights to the squares around the town hall.

Below are some of our favourite Christmas spots in Rothenburg to visit:

• Plönlein for the town’s famous yellow house between 2 towers.
• Käthe Wohlfahrt’s Christmas Village for rooms full of ornaments and decorations.
• A walk along the covered town walls for a different view of the rooftops.

Stay overnight if you can, so there’s time to enjoy the lights and explore early before the day visitors arrive. 

The Christmas markets start 20 November up until 23 December.

📽️ Beautiful Destinations Original
📍 Rothenburg ob der Tauber, Germany".

16K likes, 95 comments - beautifuldestinations on October 21, 2026: "Slovenia looks like it’s been plucked straight from a storybook 🇸🇮⛰️ @feelslovenia

This small European country has so much to explore, from fairytale villages and medieval castles to turquoise rivers, alpine lakes and mountains covered in lush green forests.

Think Lake Bled with its tiny island church, the emerald waters of the Soča Valley, traditional villages tucked into the Julian Alps and the beautiful Slovenian coastline, where seaside towns and clear blue water make you want to stay a little longer.

Whether you’re planning a Slovenia road trip, looking for the best places to visit in Slovenia or dreaming of a summer escape that combines mountains, lakes and the sea, there’s so much to fit into one trip.

Slovenia might just be one of Europe’s most underrated destinations, and we think it deserves a spot on your travel list.

📽️ Beautiful Destinations Original
📍Slovenia @feelslovenia 

#ifeelsLOVEnia".

4,071 likes, 52 comments - beautifuldestinations on October 20, 2026: "If you’re heading to Bali, make sure you spend some time in Ubud 🍃 

The town is surrounded by lush landscapes and is known for its traditional arts and crafts, local galleries, temples and rice fields, so it’s a completely different side of the island to the beach towns.

Spend a few days exploring the town, visiting local workshops and galleries, wandering through the surrounding countryside and taking your time with some of the slower experiences Bali is known for.

And if you’re looking for somewhere to stay, @kimptonsuntayabali is surrounded by greenery while being right in the center of Ubud, making it a great base for exploring the area before coming back to somewhere peaceful at the end of the day.

Definitely worth adding a few days in Ubud to your Bali itinerary.

📽️ Beautiful Destinations Original
📍@kimptonsuntayabali, Bali, Indonesia

#kimptonsuntayabali".

24K likes, 118 comments - beautifuldestinations on October 16, 2026: "The kind of Christmas trip where the walk back to the hotel takes twice as long because every street deserves another photo.

Browse the stalls beneath the Rathaus, stop for something sweet, then wander through the center under glowing chandeliers and curtains of lights. Leave time for a long coffee stop and a slice of cake between markets, too.

Pack warm layers and comfortable shoes, and head out before sunset to watch the city light up.

Save this for a Christmas weekend in Vienna.

📽️ Beautiful Destinations Original
📍 Vienna, Austria".

31K likes, 157 comments - beautifuldestinations on October 16, 2026: "China after dark deserves its own itinerary.

Shanghai’s skyline reflected in the river, Wangxian Valley glowing beneath the cliffs, and Chongqing’s buildings stacked high above streets full of neon. It’s worth leaving time to see these places twice, once during the day and again when the lights come on.

Spend an evening walking along the Bund in Shanghai, follow the illuminated paths through Wangxian Valley, or head to Hongya Cave in Chongqing for its layers of glowing balconies.

Keep a few evenings free rather than filling every day with early starts. Some of the views worth travelling for come after sunset.

📽️ Beautiful Destinations Original
📍 China".

5,487 likes, 88 comments - beautifuldestinations on October 17, 2026: "We think we just found one of the most underrated day trips from London 🚂

Comment ‘travel’ for more of @expedia top destination guides and itineraries!

Just 90 minutes away by train, this little city has Roman history, beautiful countryside and incredible English sparkling wine. Searches for stays in Chichester have risen by 30%, according to @expedia, making it one of the world’s fastest-growing travel destinations for 2027. If you’re looking for things to do there, save our list below:

📍Chichester Cathedral — Take a look at the incredible medieval architecture, colourful modern art and the unusual freestanding bell tower outside.

📍The Novium Museum — Discover Chichester’s Roman history and see the remains of an ancient Roman bathhouse beneath the museum.

📍Tinwood Estate — Visit a local Sussex vineyard to try English sparkling wine, surrounded by the beautiful countryside.

📍South Downs National Park — Head out of the city for rolling green hills, countryside walks and beautiful autumn colours, Harting Down is one of our favourites, and don’t forget to visit the famous Halnaker Tree Tunnel, best visited in autumn.

📍Chichester Harbour — If you prefer a waterside walk, explore the harbour for coastal views and a relaxed pace.

Whether you spend the day exploring the city or turn it into a countryside weekend break, Chichester is definitely worth adding to your list. 

@expedia
📍Chichester, England".

6,374 likes, 65 comments - beautifuldestinations on October 15, 2026: "From world-famous landmarks and golden beaches to coastal walks and an incredible food scene, Sydney is the perfect mix of city life and the outdoors. Here’s why…

📍 Over 100 beaches – From Bondi and Manly to quieter stretches of coastline, there’s a beach for every kind of day.

📍 Sydney Harbour – Home to the Sydney Opera House and Harbour Bridge, with ferries, waterfront walks and some of the city’s best views.

📍 A world-class food scene – From fresh seafood and neighbourhood cafés to restaurants overlooking the harbour, there’s something for every taste.

📍 Nature meets the city – Walk the Bondi to Coogee Coastal Walk in the morning, explore the Royal Botanic Garden in the afternoon or take a ferry to one of the harbour’s beaches.

📍 Stay your way – From city-centre hotels and beachside stays to serviced apartments and accommodation close to Sydney’s major sights, there are plenty of options for different travel styles and budgets.

Would you start with the beaches or the harbour? 🌊

🤝 In partnership with @all.accor @all.accor_pacific 
📍 Sydney, Australia".
